problems: Heavy OCR page duplication and misordering: Responsio ad epistolam Marci Ephesii title block recurs at lines 9270 and 10093; Alia brevis homilia / Oratio I recur (cols 371-376 and 405 pages appear twice); pages 527-544 repeat (Monitum, Verba Marci, Responsio Scholarii, Apologia, Ex epistola ad Maximum, Epistola de praedestinatione at 51817-52678); Epistola ad Plethonem head recurs at 57654; Expositio litterarum and Notitia of Plethon appear first in a badly damaged OCR run at lines 71905-72357. First occurrences are cited.

Elenchus digit misreads follow a pattern in this volume: 3 read as 5 (519, 555, 581, 585, 575, 559, 651, 751, 757), 7 read as 1 (141, 161, 115, 715), 4 as 1 (619, 715). Page headers are often OCR'd with 3/7/9 errors; bodyCol rests on the surrounding header sequence and on line spacing (pages run roughly 100-150 OCR lines).

Title blocks that fall near the foot of a page (Oratio III, Epistola ad Marcum, Notitia altera, Charitonymi, Helenae, Marcus Notitia, Nicolaus V) are recorded on the page the lists cite when the next header legibly matches; Oratio III is recorded at 473 (next header illegible) as 'disagree'.
Contra dogma Latinorum (Plethon) unlocated: no title block found in the OCR.

Editorial or apparatus matter present in the body but not in the Elenchus and not entered: Fuelleborn's title page and Praefatio to the Plethon funebres (line 89944, col 935); Matthaei Camariotae Notitia (line 96836, col 1019); the damaged 'Instrumentum abdicationis' / 'Monodia de Cpoli capta' title lines at 73367-73379; the editorial index of chapters at 89741 (col 930). The Ordo's 'Excerptum ex patriarchica Cpoleos historia' (col 311) is entered with listedIn ordo-only.

Elenchus cut (lines 171-208) ends before the Marcus Eugenicus sub-list; the remainder (lines 262-273) was read from the OCR directly. Two same-volume cross-references (Marcus' Confessio fidei and Epistola ad omnes orthodoxos) are pointers in the body, entered as crossref; the Elenchus gives each a column (1031, garbled) at the pointer, not at the text.

Greek flag is an automatic OCR count over 70 lines from the head (Greek letters versus common Latin function words); Greek-only/Latin-only/yes should be re-checked at the plate before queue decisions.

Gennadii Scholarii Refutatio libri Marci Ephesini, the Apologia pro quinque capitibus and the fragments inside the Vita are cross-references/parentheticals, entered as crossref rows without body confirmation of a text.
